newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seafront A and B shares rise.
newsitem.headline: Seafront A and B shares rise.

text.p: Holding firm Seafront Resources Corp A shares rose by 0.40 centavos, or 23.53 percent, to 2.10 centavos in late trade on Thursday while B shares climbed 0.50 centavos, or 29.41 percent, to 2.20 centavos on talk of a foreign buy-in, brokers said.
"There's talk that the company is one of those that's the subject of a backdoor listing and that a foreign firm is interested," said a broker, who asked not to be named.
A company official who asked not to be named said that Seafront is not involved in any talks with a foreign buyer.
A total of 2.806 million Seafront A shares and 524,100 shares were being traded by late in the session.
Seafront is involved in oil exploration and has stakes in seven oil exploration areas in the country.
